name: markdown-leader
description: Local Markdown reader with checklists and review notes for Chromium browsers

scripts.build: node scripts/check-version.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-version.mjs --built
scripts.build:release: node scripts/check-version.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode release && node scripts/check-version.mjs --built
scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/content/startup.js && node --check src/popup.js
scripts.check: pnpm check:syntax && pnpm test && pnpm docs:index:check && pnpm build
